# eon_finding_exclusions (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of finding exclusions in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_finding_exclusions" "all" {}

output "malware_exclusion_ids" {
  value = [for exclusion in data.eon_finding_exclusions.all.exclusions : exclusion.id if exclusion.detector == "MALWARE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `exclusions` (Attributes List) List of finding exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclusions))

<a id="nestedatt--exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exclusions`

Read-Only:

- `detector` (String) Detector whose findings are suppressed. Possible values: `RANSOMWARE_BEHAVIOR`, `DATA_ANOMALY`, `MALWARE`.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the finding exclusion.
- `provider_resource_id` (String) Cloud provider ID of the resource the exclusion applies to. Present when `scope` is `RESOURCE`.
- `scope` (String) Whether the exclusion applies to a single resource or to every resource in the account. Possible values: `RESOURCE`, `ACCOUNT`.
- `type` (String) Kind of object `value` matches. Possible values: `PATH`, `TABLE`, `DATABASE`, `KMS_KEY`.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the exclusion was created or last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
- `value` (String) What the exclusion matches: a path prefix for `PATH`, or the exact name for `TABLE` or `DATABASE`.
